correctness.rationale: Exhaustive list of nine morphisms; three equal-image periodic cases. For all six unequal-image cases, the four ordered binary letter pairs occur at every displacement at least 3, proven by finite witnesses for displacements 3..8 plus a symbolic three-residue induction. Each factor weight is exactly the common full-block weight plus a two-boundary correction; all extrema are attained at all lengths >=9. Small lengths are bracketed by the same upper envelope and matched by explicit factors. Consecutive sliding windows interpolate all integer letter counts. Packaged verify.py reran 54 pair-base/step cases, 66 boundary cases, and 9216 direct prefix comparisons; the argument is infinite without extrapolation.

value.rationale: The 2024 paper explicitly identifies periodicity of Parikh-constant abelian complexity as a motivated question. The theorem proves a complete positive result for the smallest odd uniform binary full-support family, not a single selected word; it classifies every substitution and every factor length into only three precise profiles. A general six-morphism full-lag structural lemma supplies a reusable method distinct from a routine isolated finite enumeration.
